agent_notes: The exact institution row was verified in both supplied NIRF 2025 Agriculture and Overall directory pages as Mathura, Uttar Pradesh.

The official site is canonically https://upvetuniv.edu.in/; the www host redirected to the canonical host. Normal TLS first returned the proxy self-signed-certificate-chain error, so curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests after confirming the expected official/search hostnames.

The current official 2026-27 prospectus provides the complete catalogue: undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral, two diploma, and one certificate programme. Veterinary postgraduate subjects and dairy/fisheries disciplines are represented as official specializations without inventing names.

The current 2026-27 prospectus lists both diploma programmes as 2 years 3 months; an older Institute of Para Veterinary Science page describes Diploma in Veterinary Pharmacy as 2 years plus a 3-month internship and Livestock Extension as 2 years, so the current prospectus duration was used.
The official prospectus does not state duration or eligibility for Self Reliant Mushroom Farming; those fields remain null.
